# HorizonDBQueryStoreWaitsStats

Query store wait statistics sampled of an Azure HorizonDB replica. Wait event types combine different wait events into buckets by category or type.

## Table attributes

|Attribute|Value|
|---|---|
|**Resource types**|microsoft.horizondb/clusters|
|**Categories**|Audit, Azure Resources|
|**Solutions**| LogManagement|
|**Basic** table support|Yes|
|**Auxiliary / Lake** table support|Yes|
|**DCR workspace transformation** support |No|
|**Ingestion API** support|No|
|**Sample Queries**|[Yes](/azure/azure-monitor/reference/queries/horizondbquerystorewaitsstats)|
